main.summary: Coordinates segmented transfer session operations on top of staged DataServices storage.

method.name: OpenUploadTransfer
method.summary: Open a new staged segmented upload session.
method.returns: Open response containing the initial session state.

method.name: OpenGetTransfer
method.summary: Open a new readable segmented session over committed published content.
method.returns: Open response containing the initial readable session state.

method.name: ReOpenUploadTransfer
method.summary: Reattach to an existing staged segmented upload session.
method.returns: Reopen response containing the current session state.

method.name: ReOpenGetTransfer
method.summary: Reattach to an existing readable segmented session.
method.returns: Reopen response containing the current readable session state.

method.name: GetTransferState
method.summary: Get the current transfer state for a staged segmented session.

method.name: PutTransferSegment
method.summary: Validate and upload a segmented payload range for an existing staged session.
method.param: Readable segment payload stream positioned at the first byte to upload.

method.name: GetTransferSegment
method.summary: Read a realized segmented payload range from an existing staged session.
method.returns: Segment footer metadata plus a readable payload stream.

method.name: GetSessions
method.summary: Enumerate retained segmented transfer sessions that match the optional filters.

method.name: AbortTransfer
method.summary: Abort a staged segmented session and delete its staged artifacts.

method.name: BeginCommitUploadTransfer
method.summary: Validate a fully realized staged segmented upload and transition it into the frozen committing state before external publish begins.
method.returns: Response containing the frozen committing session state prepared for publish.

method.name: CancelCommitUploadTransfer
method.summary: Cancel a previously begun segmented commit attempt and restore the retained session to a retryable pre-commit readable state.
method.param: Transfer identity for the committing upload session.
method.returns: Updated transfer state after the committing session has been restored for retry.

method.name: CompleteCommitUploadTransfer
method.summary: Finalize a previously begun segmented commit after external publish has succeeded.
method.param: Transfer identity for the committing upload session.
method.returns: Final committed response for the retained upload session.

method.name: SessionExists
method.summary: Determine whether a retained segmented transfer session exists for the supplied identity.
method.returns: True when the segmented session exists and matches the supplied item.
